title: Spicy Vermicelli Jjigae
description: A spicy and savory Ethiopian-inspired rice bowl dish made with vermicelli noodles and a variety of vegetables. Perfect for a gluten-free dinner option.
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat.
Add the onion and garlic and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the carrots and zucchini and cook for an additional 3-4 minutes.
Add the tomato and cook for 2-3 minutes, until the vegetables are tender.
Add the tofu and cook until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the vermicelli noodles, chili flakes, and gluten-free soy sauce. Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the noodles are heated through.
